brief.title: Automate B2B Inbound Lead Flow
brief.summary: The client wants to automate their inbound lead flow from Typeform to HubSpot and Slack to reduce response times for 300 monthly leads. They need deduplication, lead scoring, rep routing, escalation, and error alerts.
mustHaves: New Typeform submission creates/updates HubSpot contact and company without duplicates
Leads scored with simple rules and AI for free-text
Route to the right rep by region and post to Slack
Escalate to sales manager if unclaimed in 30 min
niceToHaves: AI scoring for the free-text field
deliverables: Automated lead flow connecting Typeform, HubSpot, and Slack

clientSignals.note: Clear scope and defined technical integration requirements.

applicationInstructions: Tell us which platform you'd pick: Make, Zapier or n8n.
Please include a short Loom or example of a similar flow you built.
questionsToAsk: What specific CRM logic or unique identifiers are you using to prevent duplicate companies and contacts in HubSpot?
What are the exact criteria and weights for the simple scoring rules based on company size, budget, and country?
How should the system track whether a lead has been 'claimed' in Slack before triggering the 30-minute escalation?

requirements.evidence: Built and maintain 20+ n8n and Make automations for agencies (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Slack, Google Sheets)

The profile demonstrates robust backend and automation experience, though error-handling alerts are not explicitly detailed.

proofPoints.whyItMatters: Directly matches the core CRM integration, routing, and Slack notification requirements.
Demonstrates practical experience handling AI-driven scoring for unstructured text fields.

gaps.honestFraming: While I have built numerous complex multi-step workflows, setting up time-based delays and conditional escalation to managers will be handled reliably using native n8n/Make delay nodes or scheduled functions.

fit.angle: You get proven HubSpot-Slack automation expertise combined with hands-on AI lead scoring for your unstructured text.

versions.proposal:
Make. Automating your 300 monthly inbound leads from Typeform into HubSpot and Slack is straightforward with n8n or Make.

You need deduplication, lead scoring, rep routing, and alerts. I build and maintain 20+ n8n and Make automations for agencies, connecting HubSpot, Pipedrive, Slack, and Google Sheets.

I also implement lead scoring with an LLM for unstructured text fields. For the time-delayed escalation logic, I will use native delay nodes and scheduled functions to ensure reps get pinged within 30 minutes.

First, I will set up the Typeform to HubSpot and company creation without duplicates. Second, I will configure AI and rule-based lead scoring alongside region routing and Slack notifications. Third, I will add the escalation timer and error alerts.

state.job:
Automate our inbound lead flow: Typeform -> HubSpot -> Slack

We're a B2B agency getting ~300 form leads a month. Right now someone copies them into HubSpot by hand and pings the right salesperson. Leads sit for hours.

What we want:
- New Typeform submission creates/updates the HubSpot contact + company (no duplicates)
- Leads scored with simple rules (company size, budget answer, country) and maybe AI for the free-text field
- Route to the right rep by region, post to their Slack channel with a summary
- If no one claims the lead in 30 min, escalate to the sales manager
- Error alerts when something breaks

We're open to Make, Zapier or n8n; tell us which you'd pick. Fixed price around $800-1,200. Please include a short Loom or example of a similar flow you built.
state.profile:
Demo profile — replace with your own.

Full-stack & AI developer, 7 years. Next.js, React, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Python.
- Built a booking + reminders system for a 2-location dental practice: online booking, Twilio SMS reminders, Stripe deposits. No-shows fell from 11% to 4% in 3 months.
- Built and maintain 20+ n8n and Make automations for agencies (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Slack, Google Sheets), incl. lead scoring with an LLM.
- Shipped a RAG assistant over 1,200 policy PDFs for an insurance broker: pgvector, citations, an eval set of 150 questions. Answer accuracy went from 71% to 89% after retrieval tuning.
- React Native (Expo) app for a gym chain, 15k installs.
- AWS (Lambda, RDS, S3) and Vercel; CI/CD with GitHub Actions. Based in Canada (Eastern time).
